plan.intent: Enter the operator ID to sign on to the teller console.
Enter the operator password to complete sign-on credentials.
Submit the sign-on form to access the teller console.
Open Member Inquiry to search for the member number.
Enter the member number to look up the member record.
Submit the member number search to retrieve the member record.
Record the Share Savings account current balance from the member detail account table.
Record the member's name from the Member Detail record to complete the declared outputs.
